about_the_game:
Welcome to the Double It!

You've entered a high-stakes competition where only the last one standing walks away a millionaire. Spin the wheel, stare death in the face, and outsmart the others—because in Double It, luck is just the beginning. Strategy, deception, and bold moves will take you further than fate ever could.

How do you play Double It?

  • Players take turns spinning the wheel and try to either safely claim the money or take a risk to double it.

  • When a player chooses to double their money, other players can press the red button on the screen if they suspect a bluff.

  • If a player correctly catches someone bluffing, they steal their money. But if they're wrong, they lose their own money.

  • At the end of each round, the player with the least amount of money is eliminated from the table.

Why is Double It fun?

  • Play in multiplayer or single player mode

  • Join voice chat with other players

  • Stand out with unique characters

  • Regular updates

  • A fresh and immersive experience

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-4350 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 2060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)

short_description: Join the multiplayer online experience by spinning the fortune wheel in this deadly arena. Take your seat at a table with up to 6 players and earn money with every spin. Remember, deception can double your cash or be your downfall! Are you ready for an unforgettable night?
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Indonesian, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Thai, Turkish, Korean
*languages with full audio support
